reason_catalog.commit_failed: COMMIT reported failure. This takes precedence over pending-state validation; it makes no further state changes after any epoch-advance clearing of pending transactions.
reason_catalog.commit_mismatch: Successful COMMIT names a different slot or digest than its pending transaction.
reason_catalog.commit_unverified: Successful COMMIT matches its pending image, but that transaction's verified flag is false.
reason_catalog.commit_without_stage: Successful COMMIT has no pending transaction after any epoch-advance clearing.
reason_catalog.duplicate_conflict: One global event ID has different normalized payloads. All rows for that ID are excluded, and none counts as a replay.
reason_catalog.reset_failed: RESET reported failure; it makes no further state changes after any epoch-advance clearing of pending transactions.
reason_catalog.rollback_failed: ROLLBACK reported failure; it makes no further state changes after any epoch-advance clearing of pending transactions.
reason_catalog.rollback_unverified: Successful ROLLBACK names an exact (slot, digest) absent from this board's verified image history. Digest alone and operational approval notes do not authorize rollback.
reason_catalog.stage_failed: STAGE reported failure; it makes no further state changes after any epoch-advance clearing of pending transactions.
reason_catalog.verify_failed: VERIFY reported failure for a pending transaction. R3 clears its verified flag; verified image history remains unchanged.
reason_catalog.verify_mismatch: Successful VERIFY names a different slot or digest than its pending transaction. The pending verified flag is cleared; image history remains.
reason_catalog.verify_without_stage: VERIFY has no pending transaction after any epoch-advance clearing. This takes precedence over reported failure.
